region_chill_delivered_provenance.nevada: Zone 9 (Las Vegas Valley) is trial-anchored: the UNR Extension SP-20-07 North Las Vegas Research Orchard field trial (2005-2018) confirms apple performance up to Granny Smith (700 chill hours, the highest-chill variety rated a performer, at Notable Mention), with the Top Choice tier clustering at 100-500 hours; the confirmed ceiling is roughly 700 hours, so zone 9 banks about 300 to 700 hours. This sits between Phoenix / low_desert_az (100-400 hours, ~1,100 ft) and the higher, cooler NM high desert / warm_arid (450-850 hours, ~3,900 ft), consistent with Las Vegas at ~2,000 ft banking more chill than Phoenix (colder winter nights) but less than the intermountain high desert. Zone 8 (cooler, higher-elevation pockets, ~500 to 900 hours) and zone 10 (Laughlin / Colorado River corner, warmest, ~150 to 450 hours) are elevation-gradient derived off the zone 9 trial anchor; no direct zone 8 or zone 10 chill measurement was available. Sourced to UNR Extension SP-20-07 (unr_sp2007).
